name: GreatCMS
description: GreatCMS is a Git-backed CMS for sites that should not depend on one at runtime. It manages only the regions of a page you opt in; everything else stays hand-written code. Publishing writes files to a repository, and the commit triggers whatever deploy pipeline already existed.

steps: Add .cms/schema.yaml describing the regions you want managed.
Read <regions dir>/<region-id>.json at build time, layered over the schema's defaults.
A missing content file is not an error; it resolves to those defaults.

pages.title: The GreatCMS Content Standard
pages.description: The file format a site must contain to be managed: schema, content layout, and resolution rules. This document is the product.
